episodes.synopsis: The first episode describes Samatarou and Tenko’s daily life, and how they and Kumiko met.
episodes.title: Do You Believe in God?

episodes.synopsis: Samatarou decides to win Kumiko’s heart by his own effort, and asks for Tenko’s assistance.
episodes.title: Samatarou’s Violent, Epic First Love Battle

episodes.synopsis: Samatarou gets another chance to get along with Kumiko, but faces more trouble when Meme creates a device to control her emotions.
episodes.title: Trembling Heart’s Roulette

episodes.synopsis: Tired of their interference, Samatarou convinces his family to transform him into a human, but he was unaware of the consequences of this request.
episodes.title: Samatarou’s Miracle

episodes.synopsis: Shinichi is in awe as he believes he found the girl of his dreams, but Samatarou has a feeling that he knows her from somewhere. Meanwhile, Tenko is behaving strangely.
episodes.title: The Season Of Love? Interested In Him?

episodes.synopsis: A mysterious baby appears before Tenko and Samatarou, and the duo decide to take care of her. Meanwhile, Shinichi is having trouble with his crush.
episodes.title: Tenko’s Baby

episodes.synopsis: Ai keeps growing faster and faster, and unwillingly gives lots of trouble to Samatarou and Tenko.
episodes.title: Growing Girl

episodes.synopsis: After finally solving the mystery involving Ai and the wheelchaired girl, things start to heat up between Samatarou and Tenko. Osamu sends Samatarou back in time since he reveals him as God to a human.
episodes.title: Important Friend

episodes.synopsis: Tenko receives an order to return to heaven as her duties with Samatarou are completed, but she refuses to do so. Just when Samatarou and Tenko are trying to sort out their feelings for each other, Kumiko returns.
episodes.title: First Love Once More…

episodes.synopsis: Suguru, an Archangel, descends to Earth and accepts Tenko’s request to wait three days before she returns to heaven with him. Meanwhile, Kumiko introduces Samatarou to her mother.
episodes.title: Pink Savings In a Teary Heart?!

episodes.synopsis: Tenko decides to investigate about Kumiko’s life and discovers the truth about her.
episodes.title: Midnight Girl

episodes.synopsis: Samatarou finally realizes his feelings for Tenko and breaks up with Kumiko. Kumiko however, tells him all the truth just before the real enemy reveals herself.
episodes.title: Kiss

episodes.synopsis: One by one the members of the Kamiyama family fall before Fumiko’s power. Samatarou must find a way to fight her, being careful to not surrender himself to wrath and become a demon himself. He then defeats Fumiko by killing the demon inside him. Tenko and Kumiko save him and Kumiko turns into an angel. At the end Tenko and Samatarou kiss and they all take a photo together.
episodes.title: The Bonds That Connect Angels’ Prayers
